description: This file defines the Subordinate class in the OrangeHRM reporting module, extending ListableDisplayField to specify display fields related to subordinate entities in reports.

classes.name: Subordinate
classes.description: Represents a display field for subordinate data in reports, providing methods to specify DTO class, relevant fields, and entity aliases.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object associated with this display field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields that this display field will include in report queries.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity alias names used in database queries related to this display field.
